title: Surface music and storefront on band public profile
goal: Aggregate the band's music catalog and storefront onto the public artist/band profile so the public page is not empty, per SIM-20260922-ARTIST-002.

in: Identify what music/storefront data is available for a band profile
Render catalog and storefront sections on the band public profile

progress.summary: ARTIST-006 band public profile music/storefront aggregation remains implemented and focused-tested, and the Wave 34 DB-008 pass corrected two real defects inside it. (1) Band media no longer reads artist_photos/artist_videos, which the active chain never created, so the band gallery always rendered empty; it now aggregates member EPK documents (artist_epk_settings.settings.photoItems) with the same is_public filter the single-artist path uses, keeping the ARTIST-005 member-privacy gate. (2) The aggregated storefront query selected listing_kind, service_mode and public_slug, none of which exist on marketplace_listings, so the band storefront request failed at the data boundary and bandProducts was always empty; the select is now pinned to real columns and the mapping is covered by the existing pure mapper tests. Acceptance is still NOT claimed: SIM-20260922-ARTIST-002 needs a hosted rerun with a populated band profile and no staging target exists.

checkpoints.summary: Implemented band music/storefront/media aggregation for the public band profile. getPublicBandProfileDTO no longer hardcodes empty tracks/products/media: it resolves accepted member user ids (excluding ARTIST-005-hidden members), queries artist_music/artist_photos/artist_videos with the single-artist public filter and marketplace_listings with status=published + moderation_status=approved (member seller_user_ids), and populates tracks/featuredTrack/defaultTrackId/media/products/featuredProducts plus track/storefront stats. components/public-artist/public-artist-page.tsx seeds the storefront grid from dto.products via the new pure mapper lib/public-artist/band-storefront.ts (bandProductsToMarketplaceListings), loads the band storefront banner/theme config for bands, and allows band storefront rendering when listings exist (empty band = no store section). PublicArtistProductDTO extended additively (category/productType/featuredRank/variants). Scope expansion from the working set: lib/public-artist/** and components/public-artist/** are the finding's named failure paths (SIM-20260922-ARTIST-002 evidence), so they are in-scope by task evidence; no other lanes touched. ARTIST-005 files (contexts/artist-context.tsx, app/api/artist/[artistName]/route.ts, lib/artist/profile-visibility.ts, app/artist/profile/page.tsx) unmodified; lib/artist/profile-visibility.ts reused read-only via isArtistProfilePublic. Verification: npx vitest run __tests__/artist/ -> 15 files / 84 tests passed; eslint clean on all changed files; scoped tsc (temp tsconfig, removed after) shows only pre-existing single-artist/library type drift (get_enhanced_artist_stats RPC name, artist_photos/artist_videos not in generated db types, venue/epk service drift), none introduced by this task.
